name: Easyappointments
description: Schedule Anything. Let's start with easy! Get the best free online appointment scheduler on your server, today.
composeYaml:
services:
  easyappointments:
    image: 'alextselegidis/easyappointments:latest'
    environment:
      - 'BASE_URL=${APP_URL}'
      - DB_HOST=mysql
      - DB_NAME=easyappointments
      - DB_USERNAME=root
      - 'DB_PASSWORD=${EASYAPPOINTMENTS_PASSWORD}'
    depends_on:
      - mysql
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 30
  mysql:
    image: 'mysql:8'
    volumes:
      - 'easyappointments-mysql-data:/var/lib/mysql'
    environment:
      - 'MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${EASYAPPOINTMENTS_PASSWORD}'
      - MYSQL_DATABASE=easyappointments
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - mysqladmin
        - ping
        - '-h'
        - 127.0.0.1
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
